name: nexus-starship-guardians
description: Project-scoped Guardian operations with live Adaptive Guardian Intelligence, automatic verified specialist learning, Benchmark Replay, Coverage Intelligence, governed Benchmark Vault learning, fingerprinted evaluation, approvals, and verified runtime workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Operate adaptive verified Guardian intelligence workflows
interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, evaluate, learn, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. v0.7.1 activates Adaptive Guardian Intelligence in the live runtime: AI architects, platform engineers, AI developers, coder/debugging specialists, AI engineers/scientists, cloud specialists, API specialists, and AI programmers are registered for live routing, and verified terminal outcomes automatically update persistent per-skill evidence, confidence, trend, and training priorities. Successful runs require objective test/API/browser/security evidence before reinforcing specialist expertise; concrete runtime failures can teach failure evidence automatically. Benchmark Replay and Coverage Intelligence remain governed evaluation layers. Automatic learning cannot grant permissions, mutate model weights live, or silently approve benchmark truth.
capabilities: Automatically adapt specialist Guardian skill evidence from verified live outcomes
Route missions using bounded evidence from proven specialist strengths
Keep ten elite specialist Guardians available in the live default registry
Replay Benchmark Vault candidates before governed review
Measure benchmark coverage and snapshot-to-snapshot category growth
Generate targeted training priorities from weak, uncertain, or regressing skills
Evaluate baseline and candidate strategies against fingerprinted fixed corpora
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks without inferring permissions from performance
defaultPrompt: Show the adaptive intelligence summary and training priorities for my specialist Guardians.
Explain which specialist Guardians have learned from verified runs and why.
Replay pending Benchmark Vault candidates and summarize which failures reproduce.
Analyze benchmark coverage gaps across architecture, coding, debugging, AI, cloud, API, security, database, UI, deployment, and tool-use.
Route this mission using verified specialist performance evidence without changing tool permissions.
